origin: OpenCode 1.18.16: the relay breaks off an answer; the client retries the same request, as its SDK does after a 502, and the relay that may still be generating is not asked again. The capture asks for a Claude model; the model is changed to gpt-5.5 and reasoning_effort is the medium OpenCode sends for it (its verbosity field is left out, see extra-opencode-gpt-request-with-verbosity). The relay answers are authored from the documented Chat Completions shapes; the expected files are what the gateway does with them.
